The '''60th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2007, were presented on January 26, 2008, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Joel & Ethan Coen Win DGA Feature Film Award, Other Winners of 2007 DGA Awards Announced|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2008/0126-Joel-Ethan-Coen-Win-DGA-Feature-Film-Award-Other-Winners-of-2007-DGA-Awards-Announced.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 26, 2008}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=Coens share DGA honors for director|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2008-jan-27-me-awards27-story.html|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 27, 2008}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Coens Top DGA Awards with 'No Country'|url=https://www.backstage.com/news/coens-top-dga-awards-with-no-country/|website=Backstage|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 27, 2008}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Carl Reiner]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Sets Host and Presenters for 60th Annual DGA Awards Dinner|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2008/0122-DGA-Sets-Host-and-Presenters-for-60th-Annual-DGA-Awards-Dinner.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 22, 2008}}</ref> The nominees in the feature film category were announced on January 8, 2008,<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Feature Film for the Year 2007|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2008/0108-DGA-Announces-Nominees-for-Outstanding-Directorial-Achievement-in-Feature-Film.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 8, 2008}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Tourtellotte|first1=Bob|title=Directors Guild names favorite directors of '07|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-directorsguild/directors-guild-names-favorite-directors-of-07-idUSN0851234520080108|website=Reuters|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 8, 2008}}</ref> and the nominations for directorial achievement in television, documentaries and commercials were announced on January 10, 2008.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nominees for Movies for Television, Dramatic Series Night, Comedy Series, Musical Variety, Reality Programs, Daytime Serials, Children's Programs, Documentary and Commercials|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2008/0110-Nominees-for-Movies-for-Television-Mini-Series-Dramatic-Series-Night-Comedy-Series.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 10, 2008}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=DGA names TV nominees|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2008-jan-11-et-dgatv11-story.html|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 11, 2008}}</ref>

The awards were noted in the media for an incident in which actress [[Sean Young]] was ejected from the ceremony by security guards for [[Heckler|heckling]] the stage and other behavior.<ref>{{cite news|title='Blade Runner' star in rehab after awards outburst|url=http://edition.cnn.com/2008/SHOWBIZ/Movies/01/29/people.seanyoung.ap/index.html|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=CNN|date=January 29, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080307151742/http://edition.cnn.com/2008/SHOWBIZ/Movies/01/29/people.seanyoung.ap/index.html|archive-date=March 7, 2008|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Garrett|first1=Diane|title=A spirited moment at the DGA Awards|url=https://variety.com/2008/film/awards/a-spirited-moment-at-the-dga-awards-1117979783/|access-date=January 22, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 28, 2008}}</ref>
